name: lovable-to-app-store
description: Plugins for shipping Lovable apps to the iOS App Store and Google Play.

plugins.name: lovable-to-app-store
plugins.description: Ship Lovable apps to iOS TestFlight + Google Play by talking to Claude. Bundled-dist build (Apple Guideline 4.2 compliant), Capacitor wrapping, automatic Beta App Review submission, OTA updates via Supabase Storage with sha256 + auto-rollback, native Google/Apple Sign-In.
